title: Spectral Saliency for Machine Unlearning
abstract: arXiv:2608.15548v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Machine unlearning (MU) aims to remove the influence of specific training data while preserving model utility. As the name suggests, MU can be viewed as the inverse of learning, using gradient-based updates to reduce the influence of a forget-set by counteracting the previously learned behavior. Recently, Muon, a gradient descent variant, has been introduced. Muon applies spectral magnitude normalization to encourage exploration of rare directions and demonstrates promising performance. Inspired by Muon, we adopt the spectral view for unlearning and propose Spectral Saliency Unlearning (SSU). SSU thresholds weak singular components and updates only those directions supported by a confident unlearning signal. We further provide theoretical justification for this thresholding approach from the perspective of the forgetting-retention trade-off. Experiments across image classifiers, diffusion models, and LLMs demonstrate SSU's effectivenes

translated_title: 用于机器遗忘的谱显著性方法
translated_abstract: 机器遗忘（MU）旨在移除特定训练数据的影响，同时保持模型效用。顾名思义，MU可被视为学习的逆过程，通过基于梯度的更新来减少遗忘集的影响，从而抵消先前学习到的行为。最近，一种梯度下降变体Muon被提出，它应用谱幅度归一化以鼓励探索稀有方向，并展现出良好的性能。受Muon启发，我们采用谱视角进行遗忘，并提出谱显著性遗忘（SSU）。SSU对弱奇异分量进行阈值处理，仅更新那些由可信遗忘信号支持的方向。我们进一步从遗忘-保留权衡的角度为该阈值处理方法提供了理论依据。在图像分类器、扩散模型和大型语言模型上的实验证明了SSU的有效性。
tldr: 提出了一种基于谱显著性阈值处理的机器遗忘方法（SSU），通过仅更新由可信遗忘信号支持的方向，在遗忘-保留权衡中实现了有效性，并在多种模型上得到验证。
en_tdlr: Proposes a spectral saliency-based machine unlearning method (SSU) that thresholds weak singular components and updates only confident directions, achieving effectiveness across various models with theoretical justification.
